In a squad with 17 nationalities from five continents, communication is key – and the Danish club enjoyed a bumper summer transfer window

If there is a secret to Midtjylland’s success in the transfer market then it starts in the classroom. Before this summer the Danish club renowned for an innovative approach had banked more than €200m (£170m) in sales since 2018, and they have just enjoyed the most profitable window in their short history.
